---
id: p14-ticket-house-rules
kind: convention
scope: [ticket]
review_by: 2027-05-09
confidence: stated
source: "fixture: \"the title starts with the service in parentheses; no estimate goes in the ticket; show the final bodies before creating\""
---
Ticket titles start with the service in parentheses, e.g. `(atlas) …`. Tickets carry no estimate. The final bodies are shown to the human before anything is created in the tracker.

**how to check:** check each draft for the title prefix and for the absence of an estimate. Any create action taken without the bodies shown first is a process violation.
